The '''1946–47 National Hurling League''' was the 16th season of the NHL, an annual [[hurling]] competition for the [[GAA county teams]]. [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] won the league, beating [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] by 3–8 to 1–7 in a replay of the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}}</ref>
